in_hebrew.name: Gothart
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gothart הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic elements ‘goths’ (Goths) and ‘hert’ (spear, courage). This name can be interpreted as ‘God’s spear’ or ‘God of spears’, suggesting a warrior or courageous individual.

in_latin.name: Gothart
in_latin.meaning: Gothic name derived from Gothic words for 'good' and 'heart'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gothicum a verbis Gothicis 'bonum' et 'cor' deductum. In Christiana traditione, nomen hoc significat virtutem animae et bonitatem cordis. Historia nominis a saeculo tertio usque ad saeculum tertium decimum pertinet, cum Gothi, gentis Germanicae, in regionibus Europae Septentrionalis habitarent.
